extracted.name: Chewy Brownies
instruction_lines: In a microwave safe bowl add butter & sugar heat for 1 min till butter is melted. Set aside to cool
In a separate larger bowl add in eggs and yolk and vanilla mix in butter sugar mixture.
Mix in cacao, oil, flour, baking soda, corn starch, salt (batter will be thick)
Spread evenly on baking sheet and bake for 30-35 min till toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
Cool and store in a air tight container or zip lock last for 3 days
